independence_detail: Reviewer did not build the packet or execute its original analysis. Review reran reproduce.py --check without writes and recomputed critical quantities independently from original source files.
scope: Prepared existing-records pilot and its cited repository sources. No live accounts, network, credentials, source edits or external actions.
conclusion: The packet is a reproducible historical sales/funnel reference and a useful missing-evidence assessment. It correctly refuses the requested product/market contribution ranking. It is not evidence that the new OpenAI Data plugin has been run or improves business outcomes.

commands_and_results.method: Independent standard-library source SHA256 and byte-count comparison
Independent Decimal recomputation and direct original-query/source-row comparison
Independent six-basket component, payout-fee, null-margin and native-currency review
Supplementary original historical variant CSV comparison using ROUND_HALF_UP
Pattern scan plus manual review of new packet artifacts

commands_and_results.limit: Untracked packet contents were additionally inspected directly; git diff alone does not cover them.

acceptance_criteria_review.correct_aggregation: PASS; device and order-referrer groups reconcile; top-N residuals preserved; order and session aggregates not transaction-joined.
acceptance_criteria_review.period_discipline: PASS; 90-day products, 28-day summaries, rolling checkpoints and August 31-day sales are not combined with the selected baseline.
acceptance_criteria_review.financial_discipline: PASS; shipping revenue distinguished from freight cost; native currencies kept separate; historical selected costs not allocated to the full window; profit, ROAS and CPA withheld.
acceptance_criteria_review.evidence_and_execution: PASS; original queries, capture time, grain and bounded source search are disclosed; Data-plugin execution explicitly NOT_RUN.

limits: Primary MONEY cells have no ISO code. USD is inherited shop/report context, disclosed in PILOT.md and analysis.json; metrics.csv should be interpreted with that companion context. Settlement currency and realized FX are not established.
Aggregate reported orders and completed sessions do not prove paid, noncancelled, non-test, delivered or retained orders. QA/bot exclusions and source causation remain unverified.
Complete period-bound order/line costs, settled fees, refund/dispute maturity, daily all-account spend and deduplicated attribution are absent from admitted inputs. No financial ranking is supported.

Source search is bounded. Matching saved hashes establishes artifact integrity, not current live account truth. Reproduction automatically binds only the primary source; this independent review checked all ten inventory sources.
The actual new Data plugin was not tested; no plugin accuracy, time-saving, sales-lift or profit-lift conclusion follows.
next_evidence_action: Continue existing TA-16 actual Rainbow basket cost and settlement qualification under its existing owner and authority; preserve remaining attribution and maturity gates.
